frozen_note: Written AFTER stages a, b, c of weekly-1 were analysed (their verdicts are in 03_tables/weekly). It is post-hoc in design (suggested by what stage a showed). Stage d adds new sample sizes (30, 300, 3000), and stage e adds a new rows-matched cadence; W8-W10 also reuse the already-run stage-a cells at n=100 and n=1000. The memory rule is fitted on discovery logs only and scored on holdout logs.

d.note: same arms as stage a plus half-life 1792 days

e.note: cadence with rows matched: the monthly round takes random people from the 28 days until it holds as many rows as the four weekly samples of that draw

hypotheses.title_en: Memory counted in rounds does not depend on round length
hypotheses.title_zh: 按轮数计的记忆长度不随轮长变化
hypotheses.statement_en: At a fixed number of people per round, the best half-life in rounds is about the same for 7-day and 28-day rounds.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 每轮人数固定时，7 天轮和 28 天轮的最佳半衰期（按轮数）大致相同。
hypotheses.prediction: In at least 70% of (log, n) pairs with n in 30, 100, 300, 1,000, 3,000 the best half-life in rounds at 7-day and at 28-day rounds differ by at most one grid step (a factor of 2).

hypotheses.title_en: A one-line memory table beats 2 rounds
hypotheses.title_zh: 一行记忆表优于固定 2 轮
hypotheses.statement_en: Choose the half-life in rounds by sample size from a table fitted on discovery logs only; on holdout logs it is within 0.03 NDCG of the best grid value and its regret is at most one third of the regret of 2 rounds.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 只用探索日志拟合一张按样本量查的半衰期（轮数）表；在保留日志上，它与网格最佳值相差不超过 0.03 NDCG，且遗憾不超过固定 2 轮的三分之一。
hypotheses.prediction: On holdout logs, mean regret of the table rule <= 0.03 and <= one third of the mean regret of half-life 2 rounds (7- and 28-day rounds pooled, n in 30..3,000 with at least 6 holdout logs).

hypotheses.statement_en: Across the sample sizes 30 to 3,000, the best half-life shortens as n grows.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 在 30 到 3,000 的样本量范围内，n 越大，最佳半衰期越短。
hypotheses.prediction: For at least 70% of logs the Spearman correlation between log n and best half-life in days (7-day rounds) is <= -0.7.

hypotheses.title_en: Many small rounds still win when rows are matched
hypotheses.title_zh: 行数匹配后多个小轮仍占优
hypotheses.statement_en: With the same number of collected rows per 28 days, weekly rounds beat one monthly round at every size tested.
hypotheses.statement_zh: 每 28 天收集的行数相同时，每周一轮在所有测试的样本量下都优于每月一轮。
hypotheses.prediction: At each n in 25, 100, 300 the mean paired gain of weekly over monthly (best half-life of each, per log) is > 0 and positive in at least 60% of logs.
